Change ONLY the far/right HIND leg RH, traced from the pelvis under the scarf into the leg ending at the bottom-RIGHT paw. Redraw the connected hip/thigh/knee/hock/paw anatomically so its planted footprint continues frame09. Preserve natural paw angle with toes toward upper-left, heel toward viewer; no flipped foot or backward knee.
For current frame 10, preserve the original animation stage exactly: near LEFT FOREPAW LF is lowered and still hovering before touchdown. The far RIGHT FOREPAW RF is planted.
STRICT INVARIANTS: same pearl-grey round-eared marten, exactly 4 legs/paws and 1 broad pale-jade curled silky tail, 2 dark round ears, same ivory/celadon/gold scarf and white flowers, crescent jade dewdrop pendant/red knot; no redesign/fox ears/additions. Full body and all decorations remain inside frame. Keep pixels outside the corrected RH leg region as closely unchanged as possible. Same bright clean delicate Taoist chibi hand-painted fur, jade and cloth. Keep existing true transparent alpha background. No shadow platform, no background, no new effects.
